title: Deployment Basics
learning_objectives: Understand PEGA deployment concepts and processes

introduction.title: Deploying PEGA Applications
introduction.text: Deployment is the process of moving your PEGA application from development to production environments where end users can access it. This tutorial covers the fundamental concepts and procedures for deploying PEGA applications safely and effectively.

sections.title: Deployment Environments
sections.content: Understanding different environments is crucial for successful deployment.

environments.purpose: Where applications are built and initially tested
characteristics: May have test data and configurations
Used by developers and business analysts

environments.purpose: Where applications undergo thorough testing before production
characteristics: Used by testers and business users

environments.purpose: Live environment where end users access the application

sections.title: Deployment Artifacts
sections.content: Understanding what gets deployed helps ensure complete and accurate deployments.

artifacts.description: The business logic, processes, and configurations that define your application
Database schema changes required by your application
Additional files and resources needed by the application

sections.title: Deployment Process
sections.content: Follow a structured process to ensure successful deployments.

process_steps.title: Pre-Deployment Preparation
process_steps.description: Prepare for deployment by gathering requirements and planning
activities: Complete thorough testing in development environment
Document all changes and new features

process_steps.title: Package Creation
process_steps.description: Create deployment packages containing all necessary components
activities: Include data model changes and scripts

process_steps.title: Deployment Execution
process_steps.description: Execute the deployment following established procedures

process_steps.title: Post-Deployment Validation
process_steps.description: Verify that the deployment was successful and the application works correctly
activities: Execute smoke tests and basic functionality checks
Verify data integrity and system performance
Check integration points and external connections
Monitor system logs for errors or warnings

sections.title: Deployment Best Practices
sections.content: Follow these practices to ensure safe and successful deployments.

practices: Always test thoroughly before deploying to production
Document all changes and deployment procedures
Plan for rollback scenarios and procedures
Coordinate with all stakeholders and affected teams
Use incremental deployment approaches when possible
Maintain backup copies of previous versions
Have rollback procedures ready and tested
Notify users of planned deployments and potential impacts
Provide clear communication about new features and changes
Establish clear escalation procedures for issues
Document lessons learned for future deployments
Celebrate successful deployments with the team

sections.title: Common Deployment Challenges
sections.content: Be aware of common challenges and how to address them.

challenges.description: Differences between development and production environments
solutions: Use automated deployment tools when possible

challenges.description: Problems with moving or transforming data during deployment
solutions: Plan for data backup and recovery

challenges.description: Issues with external system connections after deployment
solutions: Test all integration points before deployment
Have fallback procedures for integration failures

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Different environments serve different purposes in the deployment lifecycle
Successful deployment requires careful planning and preparation
Deployment artifacts include rules, data changes, configurations, and resources
Following a structured deployment process reduces risks and ensures success
Best practices help avoid common pitfalls and ensure smooth deployments
Post-deployment validation is crucial for confirming success
